comments.author: HahaLongBoy
comments.body_html:
Love the mod, however i have a small gripe with the naming you have made for some of the ammo, for instance the 5.56x45mm NATO rounds you simply renamed them green, orange, red, black, steel and open tip same with the 4.6x30mm rounds, id like to point out that most players would refer to these as a already known shortened variant of their own, take the 5.56 rounds for instance, the green tip would not be green but simply shortened to M855, the orange tip to M856, the red tip to M856A1 or 56A1, The black tip to M995 and the AP to SSAAP, i feel this would be much better naming and stop any confusion, personally i don’t think reinventing the wheel so to speak in this situation makes it easier to identify, if anything its making players such as myself have to relearn bullet names all over again, which is why i downloaded this mod to help make it faster when looting, im now taking longer to try and figure out what im actually grabbing.

TL;Dr, please name the bullets based off the actual names (in game) and not just by how they look its confusing and not helpful, this mod would be perfect if the names were just shortened from the actual names.

comments.author: McDewgle
comments.body_html:
The original intent behind this mod was to create something that made the ammunition easier for me to identify so I made this mod with my personal preferences in mind. Some users on the SPT Discord enjoyed the changes, so here it is.

However, I did take the time to set aside instructions for anyone who wishes to change the naming system to something they prefer. It’s quite easy actually, the entries for 5.56 ammo are at the very top of the config file. To revert the long names to their original simply delete the text between the two commas “” like so;

“Name”: “5.56x45mm Varmageddon”
to
“Name”: “”

Fun fact, the “Warmageddon” ammunition is based on a real cartridge designed for varmint-hunting hence the original name “Varmageddon” by the Nosler company. Same company that makes the 7.62x51mm “Nosler Partition” cartridge in Tarkov.

I also renamed many of the shotgun shells after their real life counterparts that BSG spoofed to avoid copyright infringement.

I made an account just to write this, your mod overwrites ODT’s Item Info because of the load order set. His mod uses load order +2 and modify’s original text by appending or prepending and you use +1000 and overwrite.

I downloaded the github zip and set the load order to +1 and it works fine now. I would suggest not setting the load order so high since you are setting names not altering them.
